title: Field robot
abstract: Autonomous mobile field robots may be used to maintain fields. An autonomous mobile field robot may perform soil mechanics with environment sensors at a sub-region and store the soil mechanics. The robot may further determine soil temperature of the sub-region and store the soil temperature. The soil mechanics and the soil temperature are sent to a monitoring server via a radio access network for storage and analysis. The parameters for the soil of the sub-region may be adjusted based on the soil mechanics of the sub-region with the chemicals from chemical storage units. The robot may return to a home station to refill one or more of the water or chemicals.

title: Water-fertilizer-integrated drip irrigation system for corn
abstract: The invention relates to the field of agricultural irrigation, in particular to a water-fertilizer-integrated drip irrigation system for corn. The water-fertilizer-integrated drip irrigation system comprises a water storage tank, a fertilizer tank, a weighing device, a mixing tank, a drip irrigation head and a control device, wherein the fertilizer tank is connected with the weighing device through a first pipeline, the weighing device is connected with the mixing tank through a second pipeline, the water storage tank is connected with the mixing tank through a third pipeline, the mixing tankis connected with the drip irrigation head through a fourth pipeline, and the water storage tank is connected with the drip irrigation head through a fifth pipeline; the drip irrigation head comprisesa first vibration part, a connecting pipe and a second vibration part which are communicated with one another, the first vibration part is parallel with the second vibration part, an annular pipelineis arranged in each of first vibration part and the second vibration part, the annular pipelines are communicated with the connecting pipe, and rolling bodies are arranged in the annular pipelines; the control device is electrically connected with the water storage tank, the fertilizer tank, the weighing device, the mixing tank and the drip irrigation head. By the water-fertilizer-integrated dripirrigation system, the problem that an existing drip irrigation system is poor in use effect in the prior art is improved.

title: Method for cultivating high-pungency-degree super-resistant seeds
abstract: The invention discloses a high-pungency-degree super-resistant seed cultivation method which comprises the following steps: obtaining screened high-pungency-degree pepper seeds, soaking the high-pungency-degree pepper seeds in clear water, extracting the high-pungency-degree pepper seeds in the clear water after a first preset time period, and carrying out air-drying and moisture treatment on the high-pungency-degree pepper seeds; ultraviolet sterilization treatment is conducted on the high-pungency-degree pepper seeds subjected to air-drying and water treatment, then the high-pungency-degree pepper seeds subjected to ultraviolet sterilization treatment are placed in a seed soaking solution, and a super-resistance agent is prepared in the seed soaking solution; extracting the high-pungency-degree pepper seeds in the seed soaking liquid, drying the seeds in the air, and placing the seeds in a seedling raising device for seedling raising; monitoring the seedling raising device in real time, and transplanting the germinated high-pungency-degree pepper seeds in the seedling raising device into the mixed soil. The resistance of the pepper seeds is improved, and the survival rate is increased.

title: System and method for monitoring the wear on a rotating ground engaging tool of an agricultural implement
abstract: A system for monitoring wear on ground engaging tools of an agricultural implement includes a ground engaging tool supported relative to a frame of the agricultural implement, the ground engaging tool configured to rotate with engagement of the ground during operation of the agricultural implement, a non-contact sensor configured to detect a parameter indicative of wear on the ground engaging tool, and a controller communicatively coupled to the non-contact sensor. The controller is configured to determine a status of the wear on the ground engaging tool based on sensor data received from the non-contact sensor.

title: STRAW PICK-UP CHOPPER
abstract: FIELD: agriculture. ^ SUBSTANCE: invention refers to the sphere of agricultural engineering industry and immediately concerns devices used for chopping straw and casting it about the field. While the apparatus moves along the swathe straws become picked up and delivered to the sheer bar assembly equipped with fixed knives where they become finely chopped with the rotary drum knives. To the drum plate ribs there are blades attached that discharge the mulch into the dispensing deflector where it becomes mixed with mineral fertilisers delivered from the bin. On the top and bottom walls of the deflector there are guide plates chequerwise arranged that ensure uniform distribution of the material dispersion air flow. The mixture of finely chopped straw mass and mineral fertilisers as discharged from the deflector becomes uniformly dispersed across the field with the help of a baffle board with adjustable guide vanes. ^ EFFECT: uniform dispersion of chopped straw and fertilisers across the field. ^ 2 dwg

title: THE PRESENT INVENTION RELATES TO AN IRRIGATION SYSTEM, METHOD OF IRRIGATING AND METHOD OF MANUFACTURING AN IRRIGATION SYSTEM
abstract: An irrigation system for plants comprises at least one elongate plant through (2), a main pipe (3) with a first, greater cross-sectional area, a plurality of openings (22) distributed in the longitudinal direction and positioned in the bottom of the plant trough (2), and a plurality of branch pipes (4) each with a second, smaller cross-sectional area. The branch pipes (4) connect the main pipe (3) to the openings (22). The main pipe (3) is further connected to means for supply (5) and discharge (6) of water. The water level in the plant trough (2) is regulated by supplying or discharging water to and from the main pipe (3). In manufacture, said means are arranged on a frame (10) belonging to a cultivation table (1).

title: Agricultural outdoor cultivation mechanism with electric-control lifting mechanism
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural machines and particularly relates to an agricultural outdoor cultivation mechanism with an electric-control lifting mechanism. The agricultural outdoor cultivation mechanism comprises a water collection tank, a transversely arranged liquid conveying pipeline and a small-sized longitudinally arranged motor, wherein the water collection tank is fixed at the lower end of the ground surface, and the transversely arranged liquid conveying pipeline and the small-sized longitudinally arranged motor are fixed on the ground, a three-way connecting pipe is fixedly connected to the right end of the transversely arranged liquid conveying pipeline, and the left side pipeline of the three-way connecting pipe is fixedly connected to the right end of the transversely arranged liquid conveying pipeline through threads. According to the agricultural outdoor cultivation mechanism with the electric-control lifting mechanism, the small-sized longitudinally arranged motor and an electric water pump are controlled by virtue of a wireless signal receiving controller, and the opening number and heights of draining holes are increased by controlling a circular lifting disc, so that the irrigation amount can be freely changed according to the requirements, so that the outdoor large-area irrigation efficiency is greatly improved.

title: METHOD FOR APPLYING A SPRAY TO A FIELD
abstract: The invention relates to a method for applying a spray (20), in particular a pesticide (20), to a field (24) by means of an agricultural spraying apparatus (10), comprising the steps of: detecting a field portion (32) of the field (24) having plants (26) by means an optical and/or infrared detection unit (18); identifying at least one row of plants in the detected field portion (32) by means of a computer unit (30); defining, by means of the computer unit (30), a plant region that comprises the at least one identified row of plants using at least one identified row of plants and a weed region, which is different from the plant region, in a predefined evaluation portion (42) of the detected field portion (32); determining a plant code of the weed region in the predefined evaluation portion (42) of the detected field portion (32) by means of the computer unit (30); and applying the spray (20) to the weed region of the predefined evaluation portion (42) on the basis of the determined plant code by means of spray nozzles (16) of the agricultural spraying apparatus (10).

title: IMPACT SENSING SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR AN AGRICULTURAL HEADER
abstract: An impact sensor system for a header of an agricultural system includes a first sensor vibrationally connected to a deck plate of the header, wherein the first sensor is configured to generate first signals in response to detection of vibrations due to initial contact between a crop and the deck plate of the header. The impact sensor system also includes a second sensor vibrationally connected to the deck plate of the header and positioned forward of the first sensor, wherein the second sensor is configured to generate second signals in response to detection of the vibrations due to the initial contact between the crop and the deck plate of the header.

title: SEED DISINFECTANT DOSING UNIT
abstract: The invention: a seed disinfectant dosing unit is used in agricultural machine-building. Said dosing unit comprises a seed tank with sensors of seed level, which is provided with an outlet with a seed doser, a pump to supply a process fluid with a fluid doser, the mentioned seed and fluid dosers are equipped with electric drives. At that the sensors of seed level in the seed tank are connected with the electric drive of the seed doser, and the electric drives of the seed and fluid dosers are equipped with sensors of productivity thereof. The technical result: electric power losses, overheating and overloading of the electric motor of the drive of a loader are excluded.

title: An intelligent seeder capable of evenly scattering a material
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of seeding equipment and discloses an intelligent seeder capable of evenly scattering a material. The seeder includes a chassis. Four movable wheels which are symmetrical are fixedly and movably mounted to the chassis. A soil covering plough is fixedly mounted to a side surface of the chassis. The middle of the chassis is fixedly sleeved with a material scattering bin. The right side of the material scattering bin is fixedly connected to a material storage bin. The top of the material storage bon is fixedly mounted to a material feeding bin at the side surface of the material scattering bin. The left side of the material scattering bin is fixedly mounted to a cabinet on the chassis. According to the seeder, a servo motor cooperates with a driving wheel and a chain and a driven wheel drives a driven shaft, and therefore a material added into the material scattering bin is stirred by a stirring device on the driven shaft, and then a plastic cover is opened by utilizing blades so that the material is conveyed to material guiding pipes and discharged through a material discharging pipe, thus ensuring evenness of material scattering each time, avoiding uneven nutrition for agricultural plants, and reducing the plantation cost.

title: Method for cultivating large timber dalbergia odorifera
abstract: The invention relates to the field of nursery stock planting, and particularly relates to a method for cultivating large timber dalbergia odorifera. The method comprises the following steps: digging planting holes before dalbergia odorifera seedlings are planted, putting plant ash and weeds at the bottom of the planting holes, and planting; setting fixed cables above the dalbergia odorifera seedlings to fix trunks and guide growth of the seedlings; obliquely inserting a tripod into the ground on the side face of the dalbergia odorifera seedlings after the diameter at breast height of the dalbergia odorifera seedlings are more than 10cm, and the seedling height is more than 8m, adding a brick at the tube foot, and fixing the dalbergia odorifera trunks with the tripod. The method has the beneficial effects that mixture of plant ash and weeds is put at the bottom of the planting holes to avoid water shortage of seedlings in dry season; the fixed cables are matched with cable anchors and other supports to fix the trunks of dalbergia odorifera to achieve the effects of reinforcing and preventing dalbergia odorifera breakage caused by typhoon damage; and the effect of positioning and guiding growth of dalbergia odorifera.

title: AUTONOMOUS DEVICE CARRIER
abstract: An autonomous device carrier comprises a frame (1, 2) with wheels (5, 6) guided on electrically height-adjustable stilts (3, 4), the frame receiving a control unit (10) and sensors (17), and work devices being fastenable to said frame, and the work devices being suitable for very different types of work and facilitating isolated or selective action on the field. To this end, the frame consists of a central longitudinal member (1) and a front cross member (2), with stilts (3, 4) being fastened to the ends of the latter, the wheels (5) have hub motors (7), and a further wheel (6) is situated at the back end of the longitudinal member. The longitudinal member (1) and cross member (2) comprise interfaces (18, 19, 20) which can receive signal recording devices (17) and/or work devices (25, 26).

title: IRRIGATION DITCH MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an irrigation ditch management system managing drawing of water to farmland from an irrigation ditch without going to the farmland.

SOLUTION: The irrigation ditch management system 1 works as follows: a terminal 2 is used by a farmland operator for confirming the condition of a paddy field F and instructing to draw water to the paddy field F from an irrigation ditch C; a management server 3 managing the condition of the paddy field F and/or the irrigation ditch C in the area to control the drawing of water to the paddy field F. A gate 4 is provided between the irrigation ditch C and the paddy field F to draw water and stop water according to the instruction from the management server 3, and includes a damming gate 41 and a water-drawing gate 42. The damming gate 41 dams water flowing through the irrigation ditch C, and gets down usually and is lifted when damming the water. The water-drawing gate 42 draws water in the irrigation ditch C to the paddy field F, is usually lifted and gets down when drawing the water. A water-level sensor 5 is set in the paddy field F to detect the level of the water in the paddy field F, and gives notice of the detected water level to the management server 3. A flow amount sensor 6 is set in the irrigation ditch C to detect the amount of the water flowing through the irrigation ditch C and gives notice of the detected amount to the management server 3.

title: Water and fertilizer integration technology for burying greenhouse vegetable unmulched drip irrigation hose into soil
abstract: The present invention provides a water and fertilizer integration technology for burying a greenhouse vegetable unmulched drip irrigation hose into soil to replace an existing plastic film mulching technology, so that little soil is polluted, the soil environment is improved, not only is the utilization ratio of water resources increased, but also pollution brought by a plastic film is further effectively prevented while the yield of crops is increased, engineering and agriculture are perfectly combined, and meanwhile, the economic benefit of vegetable planting is increased.

title: Manure spreader for agriculture has drive shaft for spreader discs and adjustable metering feed for each disc
abstract: The manure spreader for distributing manure from a feed container has a drive shaft (9) for rotary movement imparted to sprayer discs in a housing (7). There is an adjustable metering feed for each of the spreader discs and at least one sensor to receive the rotary motion of the drive for each disc. The housing has limited rotation around the drive shaft with respect to the frame (2) and the sensor can detect this movement.

title: Economical anti-blocking gravity type underground drip irrigation system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural water-saving irrigation and particularly relates to an economical anti-blocking gravity type underground drip irrigation system. The economical anti-blocking gravity type underground drip irrigation system comprises direct-current micro pump water lifting, water transportation and distribution, interval water supply and a pressure control irrigation device. The interval water supply device starts the pressure control irrigation device to conduct irrigation in cycles, and in each round of an irrigation process, mechanical dredging is conducted on a water outlet of the pressure control irrigation device, and therefore blocking of the water outlet of the irrigation device is effectively prevented. By means of the economical anti-blocking gravity type underground drip irrigation system, water feeding can use small water flow, an economical scheme for achieving anti-blocking gravity type drip irrigation for peasants poor in economic condition and small in operation scale in scattered non-electricity small-scale greenhouses, and water lifting and irrigation cost is low.

title: Method for repairing severe stony desertification by using liana
abstract: The invention relates to a method for repairing severe stony desertification by using liana. The method comprises the following steps that a severe stony desertification repaired area is selected, according to the site situation, a pit is arranged and taken as a circle center, and a liana planting pit is arranged by adopting pit-shaped land preparation; the pit is internally filled with a compoundtype nano-nutrient block, and the portion, above the compound type nano-nutrient block, of the pit is filled with rich soil to be flush with the edge of the pit; rice chaff and hay pellets are fullymixed to serve as a filler to fill the bottom of the liana planting pit, and then plant ash, farmyard manure or organic fertilizer are used for performing filling and flushing until being flush with the edge of the planting pit; suitable liana is selected to be planted in the pit according to a spatial allocation mode, and the liana is guided to spread and grow in different directions assisted byarticle measures. The method for repairing the severe stony desertification by using the liana has the advantages that the cost is low, the operation is simple, and the repairing effect of the severestony desertification is further improved through the special construction of a soil matrix of the liana planting pit in the severe stony desertification area and the scientific selection and plantingof the liana.

title: Method for improving saline-alkali land
abstract: The invention discloses a method for improving saline-alkali land. The method comprises the following steps: digging water channels around the periphery of saline-alkali land; digging a plurality of transverse grooves and longitudinal grooves in the saline-alkali land; sequentially laying a drainage pipe network and a straw layer in each transverse groove and longitudinal groove, and sequentiallyfilling each transverse groove and longitudinal groove with a water permeable filling layer and a soil layer; and constructing inner water blocking soil ridges and outer water blocking soil ridges along the water channels. The water outlet of the water channels is closed, and water is fed into the water channels through the water inlet until the water surface in the saline-alkali land is equal tothe height of the outer water blocking soil ridges; when the water surface is lower than the outer water blocking soil ridges, water is supplied to the saline-alkali land; when water supply is not needed according to the water surface within 30-50 minutes, the saline-alkali land is drained; the saline-alkali degree detection is carried out on the saline-alkali land subjected to drainage, and the subsequent cultivation operation is carried out if the saline-alkali degree meets the standard; and water feeding and drainage operations are carried out continuously if the saline-alkali degree does not meet the standard. According to the invention, wetting of saline-alkali soil by sufficient water quantity can be controllably kept for a long time in the flood irrigation process, saline-alkali ions in the saline-alkali soil can be fully and effectively dissolved, and meanwhile, the saline-alkali ions are driven to penetrate to a deeper stratum.

title: AUTONOMOUS TRAVEL FARM WORK VEHICLE
abstract: To make it possible to determine a kind of an obstacle and an extend of obstruction in the event that an autonomous travel farm work vehicle finds an obstacle in a farm road or farm field, safely cope with the obstacle, and continue farm work as long as possible.SOLUTION: An autonomous travel farm work vehicle includes an imaging device 9 that faces ahead of a vehicle body 1 and takes video of a road surface and a surrounding foreground, and a distance measurement instrument 8 that measures a distance from an object. A controller 20 fetches vehicle body foreground information acquired by the imaging device 9 and distance measurement instrument 8. A vehicle body silhouette 15 is rendered in the foreground video. When the object existing inside or extremely close to the vehicle body silhouette 15 is vegetation, if invasion of the vegetation into the vehicle body silhouette 15 is limited, the autonomous travel farm work vehicle decelerates and travels. If the object is anything other than vegetation, the autonomous travel farm work vehicle halts immediately ahead of the object.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Portable dichromatic wave spectrum spectrometer used for detecting nutrient content in crops
abstract: The invention discloses a portable dichromatic wave spectrum spectrometer used for detecting nutrient content in crops, comprising a two-channel LED light source, a photoelectric sensor, a signal amplification and regulation module, a model processing and calculating module, a storage module, an LCD display module, a GPS satellite positioning signal receiving module and an infinite transmission module. The plant blade is transmitted by the LED with two characteristic wave bands; signals are transmitted to a signal regulating circuit through the converting sampling of the photoelectric sensor; the weak signals are amplified and filtered by the signal regulating circuit, converted into digital signals through A/D conversion and transmitted into the single chip arithmetic unit for model computation; the calculation results and the position information received by the GPS signal receiver are displayed on the LCD screen. The detecting spectrometer in the invention can be used for rapidly, accurately detecting the contents of chlorophyll, moisture and nitrogen in crops with no loss in the fields, and can be combined with GPS and GIS to conveniently measure the nutrient content distribution of crops in the fields and realize job management of precision agriculture.

title: Negative pressure controller for mechanical variable-frequency steering engine agricultural fan
abstract: The negative pressure controller comprises a mounting frame and a negative pressure air disc, the negative pressure air disc is welded to one side of the mounting frame, a negative pressure air cavity is formed in the negative pressure air disc, one end face of the negative pressure air disc is connected with a mounting plate, a pressure gauge is embedded in the middle of the mounting plate, and a pressure sensor is arranged in the mounting plate. According to the device, when it is measured through the pressure gauge that the negative pressure in the negative pressure air cavity is large, the steering engine is started, the coupler and the adjusting block are driven to rotate, the adjusting hole and the fixing hole tend to be aligned, and therefore the negative pressure in the negative pressure air cavity can be adjusted, and the negative pressure in the negative pressure air cavity can be adjusted. A channel between the adjusting hole and the fixing hole is changed from small to large, so that the flow of inside and outside air is increased until the internal negative pressure value measured by the pressure gauge is within a proper range, and the negative pressure is controlled within the proper range, so that a good seeding effect is ensured.

title: Securing device for use at agricultural device, assembled of locking element and separate operating pin
abstract: The element (1) is made of an elastic material in a brick shape with a handle (5) protruding from one end and a projection (4) for being engaged with a part of the agricultural device positioned at the opposite end. For releasing the lock (1) a pin has to be guided through a bore (8) in the projection (4). The upper end of the pin and the elastic handle (5) are enveloped with the hand and the projection (4) moved out of the recess by the lower end of the pin.

title: CLEANER OF HEADS OF ROOTS
abstract: The cleaner of root heads belongs to agricultural machinery, in particular to the work of the beet machines. The difference of the cleaner from already known is that on the inner surfaces of the discs on their periphery there are radial guides in which the brackets installed that are configured to move in the guide through the mechanisms moving and fixing, linking arms with drives and on the outside of the brackets attached flexible whips with a circular cross section and different lengths. Ends of longer whips are fixed closer to the horizontal shaft. Technical result: improving the quality of cleaning of surface of heads roots.

title: Agricultural multifunctional seeding robot
abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural multifunctional seeding robot, and relates to the technical field of agricultural seeding, the agricultural multifunctional seeding robot comprises a walking robot, a support is arranged on the rear side of the upper portion of the walking robot, a storage box is arranged on the upper portion of the support, and a digging seeding part is arranged on one side of the storage box; the pit digging and sowing part comprises a gear disc rotationally installed on one side of the upper portion of the storage box, an adjusting rod is hinged to the edge of one side of the upper portion of the gear disc, a limiting rod is hinged to the lower end of the adjusting rod, and the lower end of the limiting rod penetrates through the upper portion of the support in a sliding mode and is horizontally connected with a supporting plate. The multifunctional seeding robot based on agriculture can automatically complete digging, seeding and earthing work, replace manual seeding and reduce the labor intensity of workers, and by arranging the movable digging device, after digging is completed, two digging piles can be opened, so that seeds accurately fall into pits, the seeding effect is improved, and the seeding efficiency is improved. The normal growth of the seeds is facilitated.

title: NON-CONTACT SENSORS IN A CROP RAMP OF AN AGRICULTURAL HEADER
abstract: A sensor system for an agricultural machine includes a crop ramp (224) with a wall (501) that curves between a first edge (502) and a second edge (503) to guide cut crops along an upper surface (504) of the wall (501). The sensor system also includes at least one magnet sensor (296) configured to detect one or more magnets (298), wherein the at least one magnet sensor (296) is positioned along the wall (501).

title: Agricultural hydroponic vegetable intelligent planting equipment and using method
abstract: The invention discloses agricultural hydroponic vegetable intelligent planting equipment and a using method. The agricultural hydroponic vegetable intelligent planting equipment comprises a planting box, a nutrient solution adding unit, a spraying unit, a planting unit, a nutrient solution flowing unit, a flowing power unit and a nutrient solution adding control unit; the nutrient solution flowingunit is arranged at the bottom of the inner side of the planting box, the flowing power unit for providing power for the nutrient solution flowing unit is arranged at the bottom of the planting box,the spraying unit is installed on the side face of the planting box, a supporting plate is arranged at one end of the planting box, and a nutrient solution adding unit is arranged on the supporting plate; the planting unit is arranged at the top of the planting box, and the nutrient solution adding control unit is further arranged at the inner side of the planting box; Intelligent and accurate nutrient solution control over hydroponic vegetables can be ensured, the planting effect of the hydroponic vegetables is guaranteed, atomizing and water spraying can be carried out on branches and leavesof the hydroponic vegetables, comprehensive and normal growth of the vegetables is facilitated, improvement of the planting effect is facilitated, and planting and harvesting are facilitated.

title: METHOD AND ARRANGEMENT FOR ASSISTING CONTROL OF FOREST WORK MACHINE
abstract: The invention relates to a method and forest work machine (1) making use of it, by means of which the control of the forest work machine is assisted. In the forest work machine, a light source (2) is adapted, which may be directed to one or more different parts of the surroundings around it, forming the working area of the forest work machine. This is adapted to produce at least one specifically defined specified-form light pattern (3) on said working area. With such a light pattern, visual information content may be produced on the working area to support an operator of the forest work machine in their work. As content of such information, it is possible to define control measures for the forest work machine, performed in any working area or their restrictions.

title: Winter wheat and summer corn scarifying, ridging, laminating and micro-irrigation water and fertilizer integrated cultivation method
abstract: The invention discloses a winter wheat and summer corn scarifying, ridging, laminating and micro-irrigation water and fertilizer integrated cultivation method which includes the steps: performing water-saving tillage operation on soil before winter wheat sowing, sequentially performing water-saving sowing operation and water and fertilizer management during growth of winter wheat, and crushing andreturning straws after winter wheat harvesting; sowing a line of corns on each of two sides of each ridge, performing deep furrow application of base fertilizers; performing corn season water management by a demand-based supplemental irrigation method; crushing and returning straws after corn harvesting. Fertilizer application rate is determined according to soil texture, the major nutrient content of an arable layer and target corn yield. Tillage water saving, coverage water saving, facility water saving and agronomic water saving are integrated, the advantage of integrated innovation is highlighted, the cultivation target of drought resistance, water saving, simplifying and high efficiency is achieved, economic, social and ecological benefits are remarkable, and the method has a wide popularization and application prospect.

title: FARMER FRIENDLY ROBOTIC SPRAYER
abstract: Farmer friendly robotic sprayers are the invention that tries to expose the usage of robotic technology in the field of agriculture. The proposed invention is implemented by installing robotic sprayers to spray fertilizers to the yield and increase the efficiency and productivity of crops. The robotic sprayers can be monitored from a distance using gadgets that are programmed to communicate with the robotic sprayers. The proposed invention will reduce the manpower required to carry out the forming activities and then decreasing the expenses of farmers. The Farmer's friendly robotic sprayer comprises the base, model the robot, nozzles, submersible pump, EC components, and wheels with motors; and which further includes two hands that are attached to arms and stomach of the robot act as a container for storing pesticides. Li0 Li0

title: Linkage control systems for agricultural tractor
abstract: An implement position control system 10 comprises an agricultural tractor (21) and an attached implement 22. A controller 40 controls lateral displacement apparatus 34 which is arranged to displace an active part (22a) of the implement relative to a longitudinal axis of the tractor. A steering angle sensor 42 is arranged to generate a steering signal which is representative of a steering angle of the tractor and communicate the steering signal to the controller. The controller generates and transmits a lateral positioning signal in response to the steering signal. The active part of the implement is automatically shifted laterally as bends and curves in the crop edge are encountered.

title: Agricultural corn automatic planting machine
abstract: The agricultural corn automatic planting machine comprises a bottom plate, two symmetrically-distributed supporting plates are fixedly connected to one end of the bottom face of the bottom plate, wheel shafts are rotationally connected to the lower ends of the two supporting plates through bearings, and moving wheels are coaxially and fixedly connected to the two ends of each wheel shaft; two symmetrically-distributed supporting legs are fixedly connected to the end, away from the moving wheels, of the bottom face of the bottom plate, the lower end of each supporting leg is rotationally connected with an auxiliary wheel through a pin shaft, a case is fixedly connected to the bottom plate, and a push handle is fixedly connected to the side, close to the auxiliary wheels, of the bottom plate. Seeding and discharging are linked with rolling of the moving wheels through respective transmission, automatic equal-interval seeding can be performed no matter how fast the seeding machine moves, the seeding uniformity is ensured while the seeding efficiency is improved, the double-layer seeding pipe and the annular guide plate are arranged, fertilizer is distributed around seeds after seeding, and the seeding efficiency is improved. And the condition of seed and seedling burning is avoided.

title: Method for detection of operating position of agricultural distribution machine, particularly centrifugal fertilizer, involves designing evaluation program to ascertain or detect certain operation positions of distribution machine
abstract: The method involves designing an evaluation program to ascertain or detect certain operation positions of an agricultural distribution machine from an assigned or transmitted data. A distribution machine is stopped or switched-off, and is situated in a transport position. The distribution machine is situated in headland, where material supply through a dosing instrument is stopped for the distribution machine.

title: Inland saline-alkali land precise improvement method based on geodetic conductivity meter
abstract: The invention discloses an inland saline-alkali land precise improvement method based on an earth conductivity meter. The method comprises: (1) performing positioning with GPS in a selected saline-alkali land area, drawing a vectorization map of the area, designing a grid unit according to an area of the saline-alkali land, and determining determination sample point positions and the number of sample points; (2) using the earth conductivity meter to determine sample point soil conductivity on site; (3) using the determined values to draw a spatial distribution map of the conductivity in the area to determine the saline-alkali degree distribution; (4) formulating recommended index values of a chemical modifier for saline-alkali land improvement based on the determined data; and (5) performing precise improvement of the saline-alkali land based on the distribution map and recommended index values. The method abandons the complicated procedure that the combination of manual field samplingand indoor analysis testing are needed to define the saline-alkali degree in the past, is an precise method with non-field disturbance and quick and easy determination of soil apparent conductivity for saline-alkali land improvement, is low in cost and efficient, and is very suitable for applications of saline-alkali land improvement enterprises and cooperatives.

title: Intelligent irrigation device based on modern agriculture and use method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent irrigation device based on modern agriculture and a using method thereof, and particularly relates to the field of modern agriculture. The intelligent irrigation device comprises a stable bottom plate, a supporting plate is fixedly mounted on one side of the top end of the stable bottom plate, a connecting rod is detachably mounted on the back face of the supporting plate, and a moving device is detachably mounted on one side of the bottom end of the stable bottom plate; a brake device is detachably mounted on one side of the top end in the moving device, a water storage tank is fixedly mounted on the right side of the top end of the stable bottom plate, a limiting sliding groove is formed in one side in the water storage tank, a filter screen is connected into the water storage tank through the limiting sliding groove, and a limiting block is fixedly mounted on one side of the filter screen. Through mutual cooperation of the water storage tank, a limiting sliding groove, a filter screen, a limiting block and a portable handle, blockage of a spray head is prevented, and the problem that the irrigation progress is reduced due to blockage of the spray head once liquid needed by irrigation contains impurities due to the fact that the irrigation device does not have the spray head blockage prevention function is solved.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR LINE DETECTION IN AN AGRICULTURAL AREA
abstract: The invention relates to a method for line detection in an agricultural area for lateral guidance of an agricultural vehicle based on a line section detected in the agricultural area. A sub-region in the detection area is manually selected by an environment detection sensor system. At least one section of a line in the agricultural area is detected by the environment detection sensor system in the manually selected sub-region. The invention also relates to a control device for carrying out the method, a line detection system having a control device of this type, and an agricultural vehicle having a line detection system of this type.

title: Drip irrigation cultivation system for cruciferae crops
abstract: The invention particularly relates to a drip irrigation cultivation system for cruciferae crops. The system comprises: a water storage tank, a fertilizer stirring tank ,and a filter box. The water storage tank is connected with the fertilizer stirring tank through a water supply pipe, wherein a water suction pump is installed on the water supply pipe; the top of the fertilizer stirring tank is connected with the output end of a fertilizer applicator; a transmission pipe is connected between the bottom end of the fertilizer stirring tank and the top of the filter box. The drip irrigation mechanisms disclosed by the invention can be used for irrigating cruciferous crops in a drip irrigation or sprinkling irrigation mode, and the water monitor is arranged and matched with the electromagnetic valves in the drip irrigation mechanisms, so that farmland rainfall and meteorological conditions can be monitored, and an irrigation mode of crop units can be selected according to the recent rainfall;a water pressure sensor is arranged on a first branch pipe for drip irrigation, so that whether the first branch pipe is blocked or not can be judged by measuring the flowing water pressure in the first branch pipe.

title: Multifunctional metering cotton irrigation device
abstract: The invention relates to a multifunctional metering cotton irrigation device. The multifunctional metering cotton irrigation device comprises a fixing pipe and a first barrel body, wherein the fixing pipe is fixedly mounted on the ground, the center line of the fixing pipe is perpendicular to the ground, a first motor is arranged in the fixing pipe, the first motor is a forward and reverse rotation motor, an output shaft of the first motor faces upwards and is fixedly connected with the lower end of a lead screw, and first bevel gears are fixedly mounted on the output shaft of the first motor. The multifunctional metering cotton irrigation device is more suitable for cotton plant irrigation in a greenhouse area, dead-corner-free water spraying in the greenhouse can be achieved by arranging a plurality of devices in the greenhouse, spraying of a nutrient solution and pesticides after dilution can be achieved, the defect that in a traditional mode, the spraying uniformity is manually controlled can be overcome, the manual labor investment can be greatly reduced, the labor intensity of workers is greatly relieved, the working efficiency is improved, in addition, farmers do not need to participate in dilution work of liquid medicines, and inhaled volatile toxic gas can be reduced.

title: POTATO COMBINE HARVESTER
abstract: FIELD: agriculture. ^ SUBSTANCE: invention relates to the field of agricultural machinery. Combine contains a digger working body with the share, the paired disks with an active disk knife, the basic elevator, clod smashers, forked guide, additional elevator, the sparse rod carrier vehicle, an elevating drum, the loading pocket for tubers and the unloading carrier vehicle. The share has a working surface in the form of manurer fork and consists of several sections with the base made with the possibility of support on the bottom of the furrow. ^ EFFECT: decreasing of potato tubers damaging. ^ 2 dwg

title: AUTONOMOUS TRAVEL CONTROL SYSTEM
abstract: To provide an autonomous travel control system capable of creating a headland travel assistance route in a headland region in a simple and easy-to-understand manner.SOLUTION: In an autonomous travel control system, a terminal storage part stores farm field information on a work region and a headland region. A position information acquisition part acquires a vehicle position of a tractor. An inertia measurement unit acquires a vehicle direction of the tractor. A distance-for-determination calculation part calculates a distance-for-determination between each side part forming peripheral edges of a farm field and the vehicle position. An angle-for-determination calculation part calculates an angle-for-determination between each side part and the vehicle direction. A headland travel assistance route creation part creates a plurality of headland travel assistance routes arranged side by side with predetermined widths in parallel with selected side parts selected from the plurality of side parts. An assistance route creation side determination part determines selection side parts, which are objects for creating the headland travel assistance route, by evaluating the distance-for-determination and the angle-for-determination respectively. A travel control part causes the tractor to execute autonomous travel along the headland travel assistance route.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 10

title: Agricultural pesticide spraying unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural pesticide spraying unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The agricultural pesticide spraying unmanned aerialvehicle comprises a vehicle body, wherein a fixing rack is arranged at the bottom of the vehicle body, a pesticide box is installed in an inner cavity in the fixing rack, and a pesticide applying pumpis installed at the bottom of the inner cavity of the pesticide box; a spraying tray is arranged at the other end of each water outlet hose, a rotary rod is installed at the top of each spraying tray, the top of each rotary rod is mounted on a fixing block through a pin, and a loop bar is installed at the top of each fixing block; a connecting rod is connected with the top of each loop bar in aninsertion mode, grooves are formed in right sides of the connecting rods uniformly, through holes which are matched with the grooves are formed in right sides of the loop bars. Through arrangement ofa stirring motor, a stirring rotary shaft, stirring blades and scrapers, added reagents can be mixed with water more uniformly, the quality of a pesticide solution is improved, and adjustment of the height of the spraying trays is facilitated; the vehicle has flexible adjustment and convenient use, and therefore when the unmanned aerial vehicle changes the direction and inclines during flight, thespraying trays can rotate through cooperation of the pins, so that the efficiency of pesticide spraying is improved.

title: Energy-saving and environment-friendly agricultural irrigation device
abstract: The invention provides an energy-saving and environment-friendly agricultural irrigation device which comprises a water tank, a push-pull base structure, a water guide pipe winding device, a fertilizer spreading device, a main support, a fixing ring, a low water spraying pipe structure, a high water spraying pipe structure and an energy-saving power supply bird repelling device. According to the irrigation device, fertilizer spreading and irrigation of an agricultural planting area can be simultaneously achieved by the aid of the fertilizer spreading device, the energy-saving power supply bird repelling device improves energy-saving and environment-friendly effects of the device and prevents birds from living in the agricultural planting area, roots of large crops can be irrigated, the spraying distance is conveniently adjusted by the aid of the low water spraying pipe structure, the high water spraying pipe structure conveniently irrigates small crops and occupies less pace when not in use, and the spraying speed of the high water spraying pipe structure and the low water spraying pipe structure are conveniently controlled by the aid of a high adjusting valve and a low adjusting valve.

title: Sunshine duration controlling and agricultural decision making device
abstract: The invention provides a sunshine duration controlling and agricultural decision making device. The device comprises sunshine collectors, a sunlight sunshine duration collecting device and a plant temperature processing device. According to the device, the agricultural irrigation reliability is improved, and the agricultural irrigation stability is effectively guaranteed.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR PLANNING OF IRRIGATED LAND
abstract: FIELD: agriculture. ^ SUBSTANCE: method involves performing preliminary geodetic shooting of plot to be planned relative to supporting laser plane and providing collation map of planning scheme; providing shooting by moving planning device over plot, with working tool being in raised position; processing information dealing with plot relief by means of microprocessor; planning plot for design mark by means of working tool with laser control system. Apparatus has planning device comprising light sensor moving mechanism. Light sensor is arranged above cutting edge of working tool of planning device. Path and height sensors are adapted for displacement in vertical plane. Microprocessor and laser transmitter are positioned in cabin of planning device. ^ EFFECT: increased planning precision, reduced time, volume and cost of plot planning works. ^ 3 cl, 2 dwg

title: TRANSPLANTER
abstract: To provide a transplanter which has a control unit capable of controlling a planting implement so as to be horizontal with respect to a farm field plane, capable of preventing unnecessary continuous operations of an actuator for laterally oscillating and actuating the planting implement and enlarging a service life of the actuator.SOLUTION: A transplanter comprises: a lifting cylinder for lifting up and down and actuating a planting implement; a horizontal control actuator for laterally oscillating the planting implement through the horizontal control mechanism; posture detecting means for detecting a posture of the float; a lifting height detecting sensor for detecting a lifting height of the planting implement; an inclination detecting sensor for detecting an inclination angle of the travel machine body in a lateral direction; and a control unit. The control unit is configured so that horizontal control can be executed for maintaining a horizontal posture of the planting implement with respect to the field plane. The horizontal control is configured so that, when the planting implement is at a prescribed height or lower, and it is detected that the float contacts the field plane, the horizontal control is executed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: Information monitoring system of liquid fertilizing machine special for lycium
abstract: An information monitoring system of a liquid fertilizing machine special for lycium comprises an informationized management platform, a vehicle-mounted positioning terminal, a signal collector, powersupply equipment and an electronic liquid flowmeter. The vehicle-mounted positioning terminal is assembled in a driving cab, the signal collector is assembled a rack of the liquid fertilizing machine,the electronic liquid flowmeter is assembled at a discharging port of a fertilizer box of the liquid fertilizing machine, the power supply equipment is connected with the vehicle-mounted positioningterminal, the signal collector and the electronic liquid flowmeter, the signal collector is in communication connection with the vehicle-mounted positioning terminal, the electronic liquid flowmeter is in communication connection with the signal collector, and the vehicle-mounted positioning terminal is in communication connection with the informationized management platform. By adopting the information monitoring system, fertilizer applying quantity for lycium planting can be collected and acquired precisely, a basis can be provided for precision agriculture and scientific planting, and precise fertilizing of the liquid fertilizing machine can be realized.

title: Garden drip irrigation system with backwashing structure and use method
abstract: The invention relates to a drip irrigation device for garden seedling cultivation, in particular to a garden drip irrigation system with a backwashing structure and a using method of the garden drip irrigation system. The device mainly comprises a filtering device with a backwashing structure and drip irrigation devices with controllable water yield, the filtering device with the backwashing structure is connected with a municipal water pipe, and the municipal water pipe is respectively communicated with the plurality of drip irrigation devices with controllable water yield through water pipes after being filtered; the single-channel controllable valve has the beneficial effects that by adopting the structure forming mode that the cylinder top cover is fixed at the top of the filter cylinder, the valve hole is formed in the center of the cylinder top cover, and the valve hole is covered with the valve blade, the single-channel controllable valve of the backwashing filter device is formed, and technical support is provided for freely switching filter cinnabar perception with a backwashing structure.

title: Irrigating machinery with multidirectional stretching injection mechanism for agricultural production
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural machinery and in particular relates to irrigating machinery with a multidirectional stretching injection mechanism for agricultural production. The irrigating machinery comprises a first water conveying pipeline and a second water conveying pipeline paved on the ground; a three-way connecting water pipe is fixed between the first water conveying pipeline and the second water conveying pipeline in threaded connection; and a longitudinal drain pipe is in threaded connection on a water outlet pipe on the upper end of the three-way connecting water pipe. According to the irrigating machinery with the multidirectional stretching injection mechanism for agricultural production provided by the invention, a liquid guide slot in the inner side of a lateral seal cover is impacted, so that a plastic corrugated pipe is stretched, and therefore, the lateral seal cover and an outer opening of a drain through hole are separated. Surrounding crops are irrigated by means of the drain hole, so that the irrigating efficiency is increased greatly. Under the circumstance of no operation, the plastic corrugated pipe can be retracted by means of a retractable spring. The drain through hole is closed by means of the lateral seal cover, so that the loss of service life due to an exposed nozzle is greatly avoided.

title: Crop planting and green manure returning device and method suitable for karst region
abstract: The invention discloses a crop planting and green manure returning device and method suitable for karst regions, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural equipment. A crop planting and green manure returning device suitable for a karst region comprises a sowing box and material guiding boxes arranged on the advancing side of a sowing pipe, a catching cage is rotationally connected between the two material guiding boxes, and a plurality of smashing rods are evenly distributed in the catching cage in the circumferential direction; the driving shaft is coaxial with the catching cage, two groups of spiral plates with opposite rotating directions are arranged in the middle of the driving shaft, the two groups of spiral plates are arranged in the catching cage, and two ends of the driving shaft extend into the material guide box and are provided with negative pressure blades; the flame tube is arranged on the advancing side of the material guide box; a plurality of groups of jet columns are arranged on the flame tube; the device can effectively realize concentrated stacking of crushed green manure, reduces waste of green manure fertility, ensures that crops can absorb nutrients of the green manure more effectively and comprehensively, improves the growth state of the crops, and prevents weeds in vacant fields around the crops from fighting for crop nutrients.

title: CONTROL ARRANGEMENT AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING OPERATION OF MOBILE AGRICULTURAL DEVICES
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to farming and in particular to a control arrangement for controlling operation of mobile agricultural devices in a livestock area. According to a first aspect, the disclosure relates to a control arrangement (100) configured to obtain from the real-time location system (50), positions of individual animals (10) and of individual mobile agricultural devices (20) located in the livestock area and to automatically control operation of one or more of the mobile agricultural devices (20), based on the obtained positions of the one or more individual mobile agricultural devices (20) and of the individual animals (10). Thereby, mobile agricultural devices can be operated optimally and safely with regard to the positions of the animals (and staff). The disclosure also relates to a corresponding method and to a computer program for performing the method.

title: Intelligent agricultural spraying device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural equipment, in particular to an intelligent agricultural spraying device which comprises vehicle frames, a water tank and a driving assembly which are internally sealed are arranged on the upper side faces of the vehicle frames, and a running assembly in transmission connection with the driving assembly is arranged on the upper side faces of the vehicle frames. An electromagnetic valve which is hermetically and fixedly connected is arranged between the spraying head and the water tank; a soil moisture sensor capable of detecting soil moisture is arranged on the bottom surface of the water tank, opening and closing of an electromagnetic valve are controlled according to an electric signal of the soil moisture content, and water in the water tank can be reasonably sprayed out from a spraying head; the agricultural irrigation device is simple and ingenious in structure and intelligent and convenient to operate, when the agricultural irrigation device is used for irrigating crops, reasonable spraying can be conducted according to soil humidity, water resources can be saved, growth of the crops is facilitated, and the physical labor intensity of workers during irrigation can be relieved.

title: Bidirectional pit digging ground drill for agricultural seeding
abstract: The invention discloses a bidirectional pit digging ground drill for agricultural seeding. The bidirectional pit digging ground drill comprises a motor box, a machine box, a baffle plate and a rotating shaft, wherein a handle is arranged at the left side of the motor box; a speed regulating handle is arranged at the right side of the handle; the rotating shaft is arranged inside the machine box; arotation belt is arranged at the right side of the rotating shaft; a seed container is arranged at the upper side of the baffle plate; a guide pipe is arranged at the lower side of the seed container; a spiral knife blade is arranged at the outer side of the rotating shaft; the lower side of the spiral knife blade is provided with a seed outlet; a forward and reverse gear regulator is arranged atthe front surface of the motor box; a distance display is arranged at the right side of the positive and reverse gear regulator; a motor is arranged inside the motor box; the machine box is arrangedat the lower side of the motor. A speed reducer and a reverse gear device are arranged in the machine box, so that the rotation direction can be better regulated when the machine works; different workenvironments can be adapted; the speed regulator is arranged inside the motor box; the speed can be timely regulated according to different geological requirements.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR AN AGRICULTURAL HARVESTER
abstract: A system for an agricultural harvester includes a chopper assembly configured to separate a harvested material into debris and stalk. A primary extractor is configured to remove debris from the harvester. A sensor system is configured to capture data associated with harvested material conditions downstream of the primary extractor. A computing system includes one or more processors and one or more non-transitory computer-readable media that collectively store instructions that, when executed by the one or more processors, configure the computing system to perform operations. The operations include obtaining the data associated with the associated harvested material conditions downstream of the primary extractor, determining a current foliage ratio based on the data, determining an error between the current foliage ratio to a desired foliage ratio, and generating a harvest-related parameter of the primary extractor based at least in part on the error.

title: Composition of modern agricultural drip irrigation equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a composition of modern agricultural drip irrigation equipment, and particularly relates to the field of agricultural drip irrigation. The modern agricultural drip irrigation equipment comprises a main guide pipe, wherein one side of the main guide pipe is fixedly provided with a flow control and time control mechanism, one end, far away from the flow control and time control mechanism, of the main guide pipe is communicated with a plurality of branch guide pipes, one end of each branch guide pipe is fixedly provided with a fixing mechanism, an inner cavity of each branch guide pipe is fixedly provided with a flow direction mechanism through the fixing mechanism, one end of the flow direction mechanism is fixedly provided with a connecting mechanism, the flow direction mechanism is connected with a blockage prevention mechanism through the connecting mechanism, and one end of each branch guide pipe is communicated with a drip irrigation mechanism. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the flow direction mechanism and the blockage prevention mechanism, a first spiral plate can change direct-current water flow into rotary flow direction waterflow when rotating, the rotary flow direction water flow achieves an auxiliary displacement effect on the sediment, and probability that the sediment is blocked at a water outlet of a drip irrigationspray head is relatively reduced.

title: Salt-tolerant drought-resistant quality-enhancing synergistic cultivation method for pear trees
abstract: The invention discloses a salt-tolerant drought-resistant quality-enhancing synergistic cultivation method for pear trees. The method comprises: step one, a land is selected for garden building; to bespecific, a cultivation site is selected, wherein the cultivation site with convenient transportation is away from a pollution source and is able to meet irrigation and drainage requirements; step two, hole digging and fertilizer filling are carried out; to be specific, fixed-point hole digging is carried out according to spacing in rows, wherein the hole width is 80cm and the hole depth is 50 to60cm; wheat straws, branches or green branches and other fertilizers are placed in the holes at the thickness of 30 to 40cm and then surface soil is added into the holes and are compressed, and thenorganic fertilizers are applied for 50 to 80kg, calcium magnesium phosphate fertilizers are added for 1 to 2kg and are mixed with soil, and the mixtures are added into the holes; step three, sapling preprocessing is carried out; to be specific, pear nursery-grown plants select first-grade grafting plants; thick roots of the pear nursery-grown plants are cut for 2 to 3cm to promote new root growthand films at the grafting parts are removed; and step four, sapling planting is carried out; to be specific, the saplings processed at the two are placed in the holes dug at the step one, the soil atthe roots of the saplings is treaded down, and then enough water is poured. Therefore, the drought-resistant capability of the pear tree is enhanced; the anti-insect-pest effect of the pear tree is excellent; and the pear tree grows well.

title: Novel straight insertion type no-tillage maize planter
abstract: The invention relates to a novel straight insertion type no-tillage maize planter, and belongs to the field of agricultural machinery. The novel straight insertion type no-tillage maize planter comprises a suspension device, at least one sowing system, a walking device, a transmission device and a rack, wherein the suspension device and the sowing system are fixed on the rack; the walking device is fixed below the rack; the sowing system comprises a duckbill cavitation device, a seed tank and a seed sowing device; the duckbill cavitation device is positioned below a geneva wheel and is matched with the geneva wheel; the seed tank is positioned above a support cover; the duckbill cavitation device is connected with the seed sowing device through a seed guide tube; the seed sowing device is positioned beside the seed tank; an inlet of the seed sowing device is right aligned to an outlet of the seed tank; the seed sowing device is fixed on a rack plate; the seed sowing device is connected with the walking device through the transmission device. By adopting the novel straight insertion type no-tillage maize planter, the damage to soil structures can be reduced to the maximum extent in the maize sowing procedure, the influence of ground stubbles on the sowing process is avoided, protective farming production requirements are met, the working intensity is alleviated, and the production cost is lowered.

title: Flexible tomato picking end actuator and corresponding picking mechanism and method
abstract: The invention provides a flexible tomato picking end actuator and a corresponding picking mechanism and method, and relates to the field of agricultural picking robots. The end actuator is composed ofa fruit storage box, a control box, a movable platform, a mechanical arm and a mechanical arm end actuator; the mechanical arm end actuator comprises a first air cylinder, a visual sensor, a second air cylinder, an air cylinder mounting plate, a U-shaped support, a spring support, springs, a profiling finger structure, a suction cup, a finger pressure plate, a suction cup air cylinder and rotating shafts; the profiling finger structure comprises silica gel piano keys, micro springs, finger rotating shafts, a left profiling finger, a left finger semicircular pressing plate, a right finger semicircular pressing plate and a right profiling finger. The end actuator completes fruit alignment, fruit adsorption, suction, pulling, clamping, swinging and breaking work processes, fruits are suckedand pulled and synchronously clamped, the silica gel piano keys have the flexible self-adaptation capacity, and then fruit stems are swung and broken for picking, so that the technical problems that tomatoes are low in picking efficiency and likely to be bruised are solved.

title: VEGETABLE CULTIVATION APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR VEGETABLE CULTIVATION
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a vegetable cultivation vessel having small size and light weight, easily installable in a clear space or a narrow land, producible at a low manufacturing cost, enabling easy management of irrigation and fertilization and giving high-quality vegetables in high yield.

SOLUTION: The vegetable cultivation apparatus is provided with a culture tank 1 holding a culture medium 2 with a holding material 3, the root 6a of the vegetable is formed in the medium 2 and water and fertilizer are applied to the vegetable 6 through the medium to culture the vegetable 6. The medium 2 contains a powdery, granular or fibrous polymer having high water-absorbency and a fertilizer-containing soil. The water capacity of the soil is increased to reduce the size and weight of the culture tank 1. The irrigation management is facilitated and the apparatus cost is reduced. Furthermore, the fertilizer holding capacity of the medium 2 is increased to enable the culture of high-quality vegetables in high yield.

title: DRIP IRRIGATION SYSTEM
abstract: FIELD: land reclamation.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to agricultural land reclamation, in particular, to drip irrigation, and can be used for irrigation of vegetable and berry crops. System contains water supply elements, a pressure-generating unit, irrigation reservoir (2) equipped with a unit for maintaining the level of irrigation water (1), an irrigation network in the form of irrigation pipelines (6) with droppers (7). System is additionally equipped with irrigation and pressure (15) pipelines. Drippers (7) housing are made of elastic material, inside which part of irrigation pipeline (6), made of elastic-plastic material, forms between the inner walls of the housing of the dropper and around the elastic-plastic flow element (8) counter pressure chamber (10). Elastic-plastic flow element (8) is connected by its one end to irrigation pipeline (6), and by the other end – to sprinkler (9). Back pressure chamber (10) by means of tees (11, 14) is connected to filling (12) and pressure (15) pipelines. In the head part filling pipeline (12) is connected to main irrigation pipeline (3) through shutoff element (13).EFFECT: higher yield of agricultural crops with simultaneous reduction of labor costs when cultivating them on irrigated lands by providing the required water, air and nutrient regimes of soil.1 cl, 4 dwg

title: AGRICULTURAL TOOL
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein Landwirtschaftliches Arbeitsgerät (1) mit zumindest einem Arbeitsaggregat (3) und einer Erfassungseinrichtung (5) zum Erfassen von Lebewesen in einer Arbeitsbahn (4) des Arbeitsaggregats (3), wobei die Erfassungseinrichtung (5) zumindest einen Sensor (6) zum Abtasten der Arbeitsbahn (4) des Arbeitsaggregats (3) und eine Auswerteeinheit (7) zum Auswerten des Signals des Sensors (6) aufweist. Weiters ist eine Energieemissionsvorrichtung (8) ausgebildet ist, welche zum Aufschrecken des Lebewesens dient.

title: Seed germination and culturing device for agricultural planting
abstract: The invention discloses a seed germination and culturing device for agricultural planting. The seed germination and culturing device comprises a culturing base, wherein a rectangular culturing box isfixedly connected to the upper surface of the culturing base, a sowing port is processed in the front surface of the rectangular culturing box, a seed germination bearing body is fixedly connected tothe lower end of the inner side surface of the rectangular culturing box, a culturing groove is processed in the upper surface of the seed germination bearing body, a moisture probe is arranged in thecenter of the upper surface in the culturing groove, a rectangular light transmitting port is processed in the center of the upper surface of the rectangular culturing box, a No.1 light transmittanceprotection plate is embedded in the rectangular light transmitting port, and a pair of No.1 transverse sliding rails are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the rectangular culturing box and located at the front and rear ends of the rectangular light transmitting port. The device has the benefits as follows: the structure is novel, the culturing effect is good, the germination rate is high,the workload is reduced, automatic irrigation is facilitated, moisture control is facilitated, and the device can automatically shield the sun to prevent exposure and is high in use value.

title: AGRICULTURAL WORK VEHICLE
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To eliminate disorder of a posture of a ground implement even during farm working so as to repeat left and right tilting of a machine body at a fine period by constitution in which the ground implement is mounted on an agricultural work vehicle.

SOLUTION: The ground implement is mounted on the agricultural work vehicle so as to enable rolling, and the ground implement is subjected to rolling control on a detected signal with a tilt sensor and an angular velocity sensor disposed in a traveling machine body of the agricultural work vehicle. A control selective switch is disposed for performing changeover so that the rolling control is carried out on the basis of a detected value with the angular velocity sensor when the angular velocity sensor detects an angular velocity of a prescribed value or above, and the rolling control is carried out by ignoring the detected signal with the angular velocity sensor. The constitution of the agricultural work vehicle is characterized by comprising optionally performing changeover operation of the control selective switch so as to carry out the rolling control on the detected signal with only the tilt sensor.
