title: SEEDER FOR HERBS BAND SEEDING INTO SOD
abstract: FIELD: agriculture.SUBSTANCE: seeder for herbs band seeding into sod contains the following components, serially arranged on a frame 1: a milling section 2 with working elements in the form of L-shaped blades 6, a seed box with seeding devices 3 and compacting rollers 4. The milling section 2 has a mechanism for sod treatment depth adjustment and is covered with a housing 16. In the back of the housing 16, seed guides 17 are installed. The L-shaped blades 6 have a wing part deflected at an angle α in the longitudinal-vertical plane. The deflected part of the blade wing has a trapezoidal shape. The blade wing has a cutout of the metal which is not more than the half of its width with the formation of the rear edge with the deflected part and the lateral edge. Along the latter, a loosening element in the form of a plate equal to the height of the deflected wing part is fixed.EFFECT: invention will allow to reduce the specific energy intensity of the process with a high quality of uniform loosening and compaction of soil in the bands after seeding, which provides the necessary conditions for the growth and development of herb seeds.5 dwg

title: Drip irrigation method and device based on growth period of flue-cured tobacco in field
abstract: The invention discloses a drip irrigation method and device based on the growth period of flue-cured tobacco in a field, relates to the technical field of flue-cured tobacco cultivation, and solves the technical problem that the drip irrigation duration is judged according to experience in the prior art, which is not favorable for improving the yield and quality of tobacco leaves. The drip irrigation method based on the growth period of the flue-cured tobacco in the field comprises the following steps: acquiring the growth period and soil humidity of the flue-cured tobacco; comparing the soil humidity with a preset soil humidity; and on the basis of the growth period of the flue-cured tobacco and the comparison result of the soil humidity and the preset soil humidity, starting and stopping of the drip irrigation assembly are controlled. According to the drip irrigation method based on the field flue-cured tobacco growth periods, drip irrigation can be carried out based on the water demand difference of the flue-cured tobacco in different growth periods, so that the water demand of the flue-cured tobacco in the corresponding growth periods is met, excessive or too small drip irrigation water is avoided, and the yield and quality of the flue-cured tobacco can be further improved.

title: METHOD OF CAPILLARY IRRIGATION FROM THE COVERED GROUND OF VEGETABLE CULTURES (RUSSIAN LOGIC VERSION - VERSION 2)
abstract: FIELD: agriculture.SUBSTANCE: method of capillary irrigation from the covered ground of vegetable cultures includes installation in the ground along planting of vegetable cultures of branch pipes with the tightly shut ends, the lower part of which has a slot, and their upper part has a hole for intake of irrigation water, installation of the pipeline with the water outlet holes for supply of irrigation water into the respective branch pipe. The pipeline is fixed from the one side on the vertical support, in which from two opposite sides the lower and upper retainers for fixing the lower and upper ends of the spiral limiter of direction of growth of vegetable cultures are located. The branch pipes with the tightly shut ends in the ground at the depth below tillage are positioned orthogonally to the pipeline and arranged in the upper part, which is tightly connected to the lower part and placed in the ground with a capillary clearance above the trough, which is longer than the made longitudinal slot, and the hole for intake of irrigation water in the upper part of the branch pipe is designed as an internal restrictive branch pipe with smaller diameter and external fixing branch pipe with the larger diameter with external stiffeners, where the vertical support is tightly fixed. The upper hole of the vertical support is tightly connected with the pipeline water outlet hole for supply of irrigation water through the internal part of the vertical support into internal volume of the branch pipe with the tightly shut ends.EFFECT: increase of irrigation zone.2 cl, 3 dwg

title: SPRINKLING MACHINE WATER INTAKE DEVICE
abstract: FIELD: agricultural engineering. ^ SUBSTANCE: invention can be used for taking in water from open irrigation channels by watering and sprinkling machines in motion. Proposed water intake device has suction pipe, intake funnel, deflector, water intake gauze, shield and flow shaper in form of ring pipe with fitted-on nozzles. Device is furnished with check valves and trap for sediments washed off from water intake gauze surface. Trap is mounted on brackets under shield and is made in form of hollow ball. Check valves are formed by flat rubberized circle with two counterweights in form of arc segments secured on non-working surface of circle opposite to each other. Segments of counterweight are made of sheet steel. Check valve turning axle is formed by strip. Said strip is secured by studs in diametric plane of funnel on deflector between intake holes in form of arc segments. Deflector is made in form of disk with cylindrical flanging over periphery. Water intake gauze has form of truncated cone whose smaller base is made with shield and larger base, with deflector through ring gasket. Nozzles of flow shaper located under deflector are orientated to zones of water intake gauze. ^ EFFECT: provision of high capacity of pump at reduced power consumption. ^ 3 dwg

title: Planting device for agricultural planting
abstract: The invention discloses a planting device for agricultural planting. The planting device comprises a basin, the top of the basin is provided with a collecting ring, water absorption cotton is arranged at the bottom inside the basin, a containing cavity for storing water is formed in the bottom of the basin, and an overflow hole is formed in the portion, close to the top of the containing cavity, of the right side of the containing cavity and connected with a water guide pipe; the end, located outside the containing cavity, of the water guide pipe is provided with a first containing cavity, a first through hole is formed in the portion, close to the right side, of the top face of the first containing cavity, and a water outlet pipe is connected into the first through hole. When the planting device is used, soil is located over the water absorption cotton, and when a plant is irrigated and the soil reaches a saturation state, redundant water can flow into the containing cavity along the water absorption cotton to be stored; when too much water is stored in the containing cavity, the water can be drained into a second containing cavity through the overflow hole, and therefore water waste cannot be caused. The planting device is simple in structure, low in cost and suitable for usage and popularization.

title: Farm tool for solving problem of soil hardening
abstract: The invention discloses a farm tool for solving the problem of soil hardening. The problems are solved that due to use of overmuch chemical fertilizer, soil hardening is caused, which is not beneficial for seedling emergence, and during raining, hardened soil cannot fully absorb water, so that water and soil loss is caused. The farm tool is characterized in that a handle 1 is arranged on a connection rod 2, an auxiliary circular steel tube 4 sleeves a main bracket circular steel tube 3, and the position is adjusted through leftward and rightward adjustment screws 6; a bearing wheel 7 and a bearing shaft 8 are arranged at the two ends of the main bracket steel tube 3, the height is adjusted through an upward and downward adjustment screw 5, and a guiding wheel 9 is arranged on a guiding shaft 10 and fixed to the main bracket circular steel tube 3; a tapered caltrop 11 is fixed to the auxiliary circular steel tube 4, that is, by rotating the auxiliary circular steel tube 4, the tapered caltrop is used for breaking the hardened soil. The farm tool has the advantages that during use, the farm tool has a quick feature, the labor is saved, the environment is not polluted, and seedlings are not damaged, and the farm tool is suitable for the mountainous-area land in which machines cannot be used.

title: Systems and Methods for Agricultural Optimization
abstract: Systems, methods, and/or processes for agricultural parameter determination are provided. One or more can include or use processing circuitry configured to: manage one or more land parcels for agricultural parameter optimization (such as soil organic carbon optimization); and determine one or more agricultural parameters of at least a portion of one land parcel (such as an alleyway between commodity crops) during a first time period without sampling the portion of the one land parcel. Systems, methods, and/or processes for increasing soil organic carbon are also provided.

title: METHOD FOR GENERATING AN APPLICATION MAP FOR TREATING A FIELD WITH AN AGRICULTURAL EQUIPMENT
abstract: Method for generating an application map (20) for treating a field with an agricultural equipment comprising the following steps: providing (S10) a field map (10) of a field to be treated; determining (S20) areas in the field map (10) with a weed and/or pest infestation by using an image classification algorithm; and generating (S30) an application map (20) specifying areas for treating the field with an agricultural equipment, wherein the application map (20) is based on the determined areas infested by weed and/or pest infestation.

title: Standing type farming apparatus comprising an agricultural chemical sprayer to recycle
abstract: The present invention relates to a standing-type farming apparatus including a pesticide spray device. To this end, the standing-type farming apparatus comprises: a standing-type farming unit comprising a groove-formed support and a fence cell having guide rails on an outer surface while forming the farming part for cultivating crops by being stacked in the groove on the support; a moving device moving along the guide rails of the fence cell; and the pesticide spray device mounted on the moving device, moving over the opt of the farming part, and spraying a pesticide-containing pesticide solution. The standing-type farming apparatus is safe due to low possibility of contact with pesticides to human body, economically feasible since the pesticide solution can be recycled, and enables farming of aquatic products including fish farm.

title: Sand covering method for grass carbon soil cranberry field
abstract: The invention relates to a sand covering method for a grass carbon soil cranberry field, which aims at solving the problems of slow temperature rise in spring and cold low temperature in the prior artof artificial planting of the cranberry in the peat soil, which are not beneficial to the growth of the cranberry in spring, and the problem that the fruits are reduced in yield due to the fact thatthe branches grow and the fruits are immature. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, transplanting and planting a grass carbon soil cranberry field, irrigating frozen ice to the cranberryfield when the temperature falls below minus 7 DEG C in the winter of 3-4 years after the planting, placing a barrel of white vinegar at a water inlet of a field block, and punching three holes at equal intervals at the bottom of the side surface of the barrel so as to lead the white vinegar to enter the field along with the irrigation water; step 2, covering sand from January to February, and uniformly spreading the sand on the frozen field by using an ice spreading method. According to the sand covering method for the grass carbon soil cranberry field, favorable conditions for increasing theyield of the fruits are created, and the yield of the fruits is increased by 20-25%. The method is applied to the field of plant cultivation.

title: Agricultural harvesting machine with pre-emergence weed detection and mitigation system
abstract: An agricultural harvesting machine includes crop processing functionality configured to engage crop in a field, perform a crop processing operation on the crop, and move the processed crop to a harvested crop repository, and a control system configured to identify a weed seed area indicating presence of weed seeds, and generate a control signal associated with a pre-emergence weed seed treatment operation based on the identified weed seed area.

title: Negative pressure adjusted and controlled close type cultivation system and operation method
abstract: A negative pressure controlled closed culture system is composed of water pool, water-delivery trunk, water level controller, culturing containers with impervious wall, osmotic irrigation system, root isolating films, culture medium filled in said culturing containers, and branch water tubes connected to said water-delivering trunk. Its advantage is saving water and fertilizer.

title: Flexible traction resonance type picking equipment
abstract: The invention relates to flexible traction resonance type picking equipment, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural machinery, the flexible traction resonance type picking equipment comprises a picking rack, a traction driving mechanism, a traction excitation mechanism and a flexible traction mechanism, the traction driving mechanism is fixed on the picking rack, the traction excitation mechanism is arranged between the flexible traction mechanism and the traction driving mechanism, and the flexible traction mechanism is fixed on the picking rack. The traction excitation mechanism is movably connected with the traction driving mechanism and the flexible traction mechanism; the flexible traction mechanism is a flexible traction piece or is composed of the flexible traction piece and a tensioning mechanism, and the traction excitation mechanism is a traction excitation mechanism with guidance or a traction excitation mechanism without guidance. The device has the characteristics of simple structure, light weight, high efficiency and low energy consumption. The dilemma that forest fruit picking is inorganic and available and the livelihood problem that manual picking is not carried out on trees and production is safe are solved, the technical limitation of overseas large-scale harvesting equipment is broken through, and small-sized digital agricultural machinery equipment suitable for resonance type harvesting of forest fruit crowns in mountainous areas in China is formed.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR FIELD TREATMENT AND MONITORING
abstract: Systems and methods of using an unmanned aerial or land vehicle (e.g. drone) for agricultural and/or pest control applications, such as on farms, golf courses, parks, and/or along roadways, power lines, etc.

title: Water-saving plant root-zone manual intervention method
abstract: The invention provides a water-saving plant root-zone manual intervention method and relates to the field of agricultural planting. The method comprises the steps of a, determining a water dropping point, b, treating plant attached soil, c, forming a root limiting groove, d, putting the attached soil knocked down in the step b into the root limiting groove, holding the plant root zone together and putting into the root limiting groove, and locating the parting of the plant ground part and the root system at the small end of the root limiting groove, e, digging a hole, f, firstly putting the sector end of the root limiting groove into the hole, and g, backfilling soil. The method is capable of realizing the limitation of the root zone of the plant in the development direction in the process of transplanting the plane; water in drip irrigation all flows into the root limiting groove and the root system of the plant is capable of basically absorbing all the water; under the premise of providing the water of the same amount, the plant can grow better. In addition, the root system of the plant is limited, and allowed by conditions such as illumination, dense planting of the plant can be realized and the land resource can be utilized thoroughly. The water-saving plant root-zone manual intervention method has relatively high market popularization and application value.

title: Air-aspiration type precise seed taking device
abstract: The invention relates to a component for an agricultural seeding machine, in particular to an air-aspiration type precise seed taking device which can be used for a precise seeding machine. The air-aspiration type precise seed taking device mainly comprises a negative pressure cavity (1), a seed sucking disc (3) and an installation shaft (4), wherein the seed sucking disc (3) is fixedly connected to the end part of the negative pressure cavity (1); the installation shaft (4) is connected with the negative pressure cavity (1) through a bearing (6); an air stopping block is arranged in the negative pressure cavity (1); the air stopping block is connected with the installation shaft (4) and is in sliding or rolling fit with the seed sucking disc (3); and the contact area between the air stopping block and the seed sucking disc at least covers one seed sucking hole (2). The invention has the advantages that: the overall structural design is scientific, the transmission is stable, and the rotation of the negative pressure cavity is combined with the air stopping of a sliding block to realize precise seeding; the air tightness of the negative pressure cavity is good, thus the negative pressure is more stabilized, the seed taking rate is improved, and the hole rate is reduced; the service life of the seed sucking disc is prolonged, and the power consumption is reduced; and the negative pressure seal is airtight and reliable, and the service performance is stable, thus the precise seed taking quality and stability are further improved.

title: Automatic irrigation and drainage device
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic irrigation and drainage device, which belongs to the technical field of irrigation and drainage, and is characterized in that the automatic irrigation and drainage device comprises a device body, the device body comprises a water source pool, a driving device frame and a drainage hose, and a first liquid level sensor is fixedly mounted above the inner side wall of the water source pool; a plurality of uniformly distributed universal wheels are fixedly connected to the lower end of the driving device frame, a water pump, a control cabinet, a full-automatic gravel filter and a fertilizer applying device are sequentially and fixedly connected to the upper end of the driving device frame from left to right, a third control valve on the outer side wall of a multi-way pipe is opened to facilitate irrigation treatment on a farmland, and a fertilizer outlet pipe is opened to facilitate fertilizer applying treatment on the farmland. Chemical fertilizer and irrigation water are conveniently and synchronously conveyed out, the purpose of synchronous irrigation and fertilization is achieved, fertilization is conducted after the fertilizer is dissolved, the fertilization quality is improved, the driving device frame is convenient to move, the automatic irrigation and drainage device can be conveniently used in places with different water sources, and the use performance of the automatic irrigation and drainage device is enhanced.

title: LIQUID SPRAYER
abstract: FIELD: agriculture, in particular, plant protection equipment for spraying liquid pesticides and biological preparations in the form of monodisperse mist. ^ SUBSTANCE: liquid sprayer has casing accommodating electric engine covered with closure fixed on casing by bolts and nuts with washers. Reinforced rubber collar is mounted on electric engine shaft for isolating electric engine from penetration of solution into casing and flange is fixed on said shaft for baffling working fluid. Impeller is made in the form of part of tore cut along horizontal axis and fixed on end of electric engine shaft by means of nut with washer. Casing is fixed to base by screws and nuts with washers. Dosing unit including replaceable dosing device, valve, spring with related guiding stem, sleeve and cover is mounted in base boss. Dosing device is made gauged and fixed through thread into mouth of L-shaped opening in base body. Lower part of L-shaped opening including gauged dosing device is positioned for arranging the latter at right angle relative to lowermost point of impeller. Liquid sprayer kit includes at least three replaceable dosing devices having differently gauged openings. ^ EFFECT: increased efficiency in spraying liquid in the form of monodisperse mist settling onto area under treatment process and adapted for covering plants. ^ 2 dwg

title: Cart with farmland soil loosening and irrigation functions
abstract: The invention discloses a cart with farmland soil loosening and irrigation functions. The cart comprises a main box body, a stirring cavity with an upward opening is formed in the main box body, a storage cavity is formed in the lower side of the main box body, water passing cavities with the upper sides communicating with the lower wall of the stirring cavity are formed in the left side and the right side of the storage cavity in a communicating manner, and spray head cavities are formed in the lower sides of the water passing cavities in a communicating manner; and a roller cavity with a downward opening is formed in the lower side of each spray head cavity in a communicating manner, the lower wall of the stirring cavity is rotationally connected with a stirring shaft extending downwardsinto the storage cavity, and the outer circle face of the end, located in the storage cavity, of the stirring shaft is rotationally connected with a first winding wheel. According to the cart, rollermechanisms with the adjustable intervals are used for adapting to different farmland widths, and meanwhile, a water and fertilizer integrated device is arranged, so that channels can be opened in theusing process, water and fertilizer irrigation is conducted, and the channels are closed at the same time when not needed; and a soil turning mechanism in linkage with a power shaft is arranged.

title: METHOD FOR OPERATING AN AGRICULTURAL VEHICLE-IMPLEMENT COMBINATION
abstract: Die Erfindung betrifft ein Verfahren für den Betrieb eines landwirtschaftlichen Gespanns 1, wobei das landwirtschaftliche Gespann 1 eine landwirtschaftliche Arbeitsmaschine 2, ein landwirtschaftliches Anbaugerät 3 und ein Fahrerassistenzsystem 6 mit einer Recheneinheit 7, einer Anzeigeeinheit 8 und einer Sensoranordnung 9 aufweist, wobei das Fahrerassistenzsystem 6 einen Einstellautomaten 12 bereitstellt, der nach mindestens einer Optimierungsstrategie 13 unter Anwendung eines Systemmodells 14 auf die aktuelle Betriebssituation B fortlaufend eine Optimierung der Arbeitsweise der Arbeitsmaschine 2 und/oder des Anbaugeräts 3 bewirkt und Stellwerte 15, 16 für Maschinenparameter an die landwirtschaftliche Arbeitsmaschine 2 und/oder das landwirtschaftliche Anbaugerät 3 übergibt. Es wird vorgeschlagen, dass mittels des Fahrerassistenzsystems 6 zur Einschätzung der erreichbaren Arbeitsgüte des Einstellautomaten 12 die aktuelle Betriebssituation B mit mindestens einem Güteindikator G<sub>i</sub> daraufhin bewertet wird, inwieweit die aktuelle Betriebssituation B mit ihren Betriebsparametern B<sub>i</sub> innerhalb des Systemmodells 14 liegt.

title: Trailer apparatus of large swath-width for agricultural work has soil-working or sowing elements able to be retracted by setting elements
abstract: The trailer apparatus has side frames (6) carrying soil-working or sowing elements (7), which can be retracted towards the side frames by setting elements (20). The sowing elements are attached to the side frames at the level of buried guide elements (19) digging into the soil. The latter can be retracted towards the side frames.

title: Novel agricultural fertilization device
abstract: The invention discloses a novel agricultural fertilization device which comprises a fertilizer barrel for loading fertilizer and a cart for pushing the fertilizer barrel, wherein a mortise lock structure is arranged between the fertilizer barrel and the cart; the mortise lock structure comprises insertion gussets arranged at four corners of the top end surface of the cart and insertion slots formed in the four corners of the bottom end surface of the fertilizer barrel and in insertion fit with the insertion gussets; protection devices are symmetrically arranged in the front and at the back inthe cart; each protection device comprises a first push-press slot formed in the cart and with a downward port; a sliding block is mounted, in an up-down sliding manner, in the first push-press slot;a rubber sheet is fixed on the bottom end surface of the sliding block; first guide slots extending up and down are symmetrically formed in the left and right side walls of the first push-press slot;a first guide block is mounted, in a sliding manner, in each first guide slot; the first guide blocks are fixedly connected with the sliding blocks; a second push-press slot in left-right communication is formed in each sliding block.

title: Micro-ridge mixed sowing cultivation method for dry land crops
abstract: The invention discloses a micro-ridge mixed sowing cultivation method for dry land crops. The method comprises the following steps: S1, performing dry land ditch cleaning and drainage; S2, harvestingpreceding crops, reserving stubbles, crushing straw of the preceding crops, and spreading the crushed straw on the reserved stubbles; S3, conducting ditching on the dry land to form ecological ditches; and S4, flattening the vertical stubbles and the crushed straw on the compartment surface to form a lower cushion surface, forming a seed fertilizer mud compound into a ridge shape, enabling the compound to fall on the lower cushion surface to form ecological ridges, forming a plurality of ecological ridges between the adjacent ecological ditches, forming ecological recesses between the adjacentecological ridges, and performing Paomashui irrigating once after sowing, wherein the seed fertilizer mud compound is prepared by uniformly stirring and mixing soil, dry land crop seeds and a chemical fertilizer. Firstly, the ecological ridges are used as a medium to wrap organisms and vegetative bodies and is heat-insulating, moisture-preserving, water-permeable and air-permeable; and secondly,the ecological ridges are used as a donor to provide water nutrition for organism vegetative mass. The selected seeds in the ridges grow faster than weed seeds in the ridges and outside the ridges, and roots and leaves grow smoothly.

title: Equipment capable of conveniently spraying liquid pesticide to grapes
abstract: The invention discloses equipment capable of conveniently spraying liquid pesticide to grapes, and particularly relates to the technical field of sampling. The equipment comprises an outer shell, a liquid collecting device and a liquid passing device, wherein the liquid collecting device and the liquid passing device are both arranged in the outer shell; the liquid collecting device comprises a barrel body, an upper grid baffle plate, a lower grid baffle plate and an annular water pressurizing isolating ring; the upper grid baffle plate and the lower grid baffle plate are respectively and fixedly arranged at the side end of the barrel body, the upper end of the annular water pressurizing isolating ring is fixed with the upper grid baffle plate, the lower end of the annular water pressurizing isolating ring is fixed with the lower grid baffle plate, and a through hole is formed in the annular water pressurizing isolating ring. The invention aims to provide the equipment for conveniently spraying the liquid pesticide to the grapes, and when the equipment is used, the liquid pesticide can be sprayed more uniformly, so that the work of fruit farmers is greatly improved.

title: Lightweight operation vehicle for orchard pruning, thinning and interplanting
abstract: The invention discloses a portable orchard pruning, thinning and interplanting operation vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of mechanical equipment for agriculture and forestry. An orchard pruning, thinning and sleeve picking portable operation vehicle comprises a vehicle body, a hydraulic rod is installed on the top face of the vehicle body, an operation hopper is connected to the upper end of the hydraulic rod, a fruit receiving hopper is connected to the right end of a fruit guide groove, and a ladder is welded to the outer wall of the left side of the operation hopper. According to the screening assembly below the fruit guide groove, due to the fact that a plurality of adjusting plates can form a conical structure, the distance between the front adjusting plate and the rear adjusting plate can be slowly increased from right to left, when the fruits pass by, small fruits can fall off from the right side, then medium fruits can fall off from the middle, large fruits can fall off from the left side, and the fruits are collected through a collecting box; the purpose of screening, classifying and placing the fruits is achieved, secondary classification is not needed, and the picking efficiency is greatly improved.

title: Particulate matter fast split charging, pre-mixing and counting device and method
abstract: The invention provides a particulate matter fast split charging, pre-mixing and counting device and a method, and relate to the technical field of particulate matter split charging, mixing and counting. The particulate matter fast split charging, pre-mixing and counting device comprises a material guide rolling tube (1), a motor (2), a control system, a dust collector air suction pipe (3), a blanking plate (10), an excessive material cleaning hair brush (13), a material box (12) or a material guide groove (9) and a material suction hole plug-prevention cleaning hair brush (11), wherein the material guide rolling tube (1) is arranged on a machine frame (4), the motor (2) and the control system drive the guide rolling tube to operate, and the dust collector air suction pipe (3) are in gap-existence connection with the material guide rolling tube. The particulate matter fast split charging, pre-mixing and counting device and the method have wide application to the fields of industry, agriculture, manufacturing industry, metering and the like, is suitable for the split charging, mixing and counting of all non-sticky small-sized round or approximately round particulate matters, and has the advantages that the structure is simple, and the popularization and the generalization are easy.

title: CONTROL SYSTEM OF SOWING COMPLEXES
abstract: FIELD: agricultural engineering.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to the field of agricultural engineering. The control system of the sowing complex contains a parameter display unit, a data collection unit, a programmable start unit for the electromagnetic coupling of the metering device drive and sensors for monitoring the technological process of sowing seeds. The system is additionally equipped with a cultivator lift control unit consisting of a pressure switch, an electromagnetic valve for the flow of hydraulic fluid and a safety valve, interacting with the tractor hydraulic system and a programmable unit for starting the electromagnetic coupling of the metering device drive with the possibility of pre-disconnecting the electromagnetic coupling of the metering device drive before the cultivators of the sowing complex are dug out at the edge of the field during a U-turn and preventing the blowing of seed material onto the field surface from pneumatic seed pipelines. These elements of the control system of the sowing complex are connected to each other according to the figure.EFFECT: information content about the course and quality of seed sowing is expanded both for each row and for the field as a whole, quickly affecting the improvement of the quality of sowing and reducing seed losses.1 cl, 1 dwg

title: Purification facility for animals and plants to absorb and utilize town sewage and household garbage
abstract: The invention relates to a town sewage purification treatment facility, in particular to a purification facility for absorbing and utilizing town sewage and household garbage by using animals and plants. A full-automatic tower-free water feeder is connected with a plant purification facility for lifting irrigation of a buried infiltrating irrigation pipe network and animals and plants in agricultural and fishing areas such as fish ponds and lotus root fields to absorb and utilize sewage in sewers and rivers in cities and towns; the good effects of beautifying the environment, purifying water and storing soil can be achieved, and high-yield and high-quality economic forest green belts and agricultural and fishing products can also create rich economic benefits.

title: Seeding quantity adjusting and controlling device based on gearbox for seeder and using method of device
abstract: The invention discloses a seeding quantity adjusting and controlling device based on a gearbox for a seeder and a using method of the device and belongs to the technical field of agricultural mechanical equipment. The device comprises a seed box and a rack arranged at the lower end of the seed box, wherein the two ends of the rack are movably connected with ground wheels through rotating shafts respectively, one rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a connecting gear case, and the gearbox is arranged on the outer side of the seed box; a coupler is arranged at the lower end of the front side of the gearbox, the connecting gear case is in transmission connection with the coupler through a universal transmission shaft, and a gear changer connected with the coupler and a high-low speed regulator in transmission connection with the gear changer through a transmission shaft are fixedly arranged in the gearbox; the gear changer and the high-low speed regulator are movably connected with a gear shifting handle and a high-low speed regulating handle respectively, wherein one ends of the gear shifting handle and high-low speed regulating handle are arranged on the outer side of the gearbox; an output end of the high-low speed regulator is fixedly connected with a rotating rod arranged on the inner side of the lower portion of the seed box, and the rotating rod is provided with a plurality of rotating teeth which are uniformly distributed. The device has the advantages of good seeding quantity control effect, uniform seeding and more precise transmission.

title: Methods for treatment of crops by an irrigation solution
abstract: The present invention provides a unique method and apparatus for improving crop yield through the use of an inventive irrigation solution to inhibit surface pathogens, improved water penetration and increase crop production and market quality. In a presently preferred embodiment, the inventive method comprises the steps of producing a gaseous mixture of negatively charged ionized air including from about 50 parts per million to about 4,000 parts per million ozone, from about 1,000 parts per million to 20,000 parts per million oxygen ions, and from 2,000 to about 50,000 parts per million nitrogen oxides from ambient air; effecting direct contact between the ionized air gaseous mixture and a supply of water by means of a submicron injector to produce a gaseous solution for treatment of irrigation water to be applied to agricultural crops. Accordingly, by treating the crops during irrigation the inventive process promotes plant growth and inhibits harmful insects and parasites on plants above ground.

title: Pitaya root-cutting high-yield planting method
abstract: The invention discloses a pitaya root-cutting high-yield planting method, and belongs to the technical field of pitaya planting. The pitaya root-cutting high-yield planting method comprises the following steps that S1, an orchard is selected, specifically, a pitaya orchard in which pitaya trees grow well at the age of 6-7 years and have good growth vigour is selected; S2, roots are cut, specifically, root cutting is carried out on the pitaya fruit trees in the selected pitaya orchard once every three years; and S3, maintenance is carried out, specifically, organic fertilizer is additionally applied to the pitaya trees after root cutting. The root cutting method comprises the steps that hair roots 30 cm away from the main root of the dragon fruit tree are cut off, the root cutting amount is 60%-80%, and the root cutting time is winter; after the roots are cut in winter, a rooting agent is sprayed to the cut roots; then organic fertilizer is additionally applied in spring; and watering is carried out, and water flows into soil along the outer wall of the stand column used for cultivating the dragon fruit trees. The problem that the yield of old pitaya trees with the tree age of more than five years is low is solved, the yield of pitaya can be effectively increased, economic benefits are increased, and irrigation is convenient.

title: Low-cost multifunctional rice harvesting machine
abstract: The invention relates to a low-cost multifunctional rice harvesting machine, and belongs to agricultural machines. Road wheels on axle shafts on the two sides of a handle are changed into gears 44.5 centimeters in diameter and 3 centimeters in thickness, a front wheel and a back wheel which are 50.2 centimeters in diameter and 50 centimeters in width are driven by the gears, one end is provided with an invisible gear and is coincident with the upper gears of the axle shafts, the other end is provided with a mud cutting sheet, a mud stopping sheet and an anti-falling sheet in a welded mode, the upper edge of the front end of a machine body is provided with a straight face threshing cylinder and a concave iron sheet provided with four closed walls and matched with the straight face threshing cylinder, an upwards-bent iron sheet the same as the convex-lower-end front stopping edge in width is welded to the convex-lower-end front stopping edge, and rice ear comb guide sheets large in exterior and small in interior are welded to the two ends of the bottom edge of the convex-lower-end front stopping edge. A finger-shaped air guide pipe is installed on the lower edge. A diesel engine, a variable shaft and an air blower are arranged on the harvesting machine. An operation seat is arranged on a platform on the back wheel, a rice conveying plate barrel where rice passes is arranged at the position from the threshing cylinder to the back portion of the operation seat, and the rice falls into bags from the back of the operation seat. A high-speed cutting sheet is installed at the bottom of the middle of the machine body. The two sides of the back end of the machine body are respectively provided with a small plowshare.

title: Pesticide spraying equipment for modern agriculture
abstract: The invention discloses pesticide spraying equipment for modern agriculture. The equipment comprises a supporting plate, supporting leg columns are both fixedly connected to the two sides of the bottom of the supporting plate, first bearings are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the supporting leg columns, the bottoms of the first bearings are fixedly connected with connecting blocks, the bottoms of the connecting blocks are movably connected with rolling wheels, and the left side of the top of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a stirring box. According to the equipment, a rotary pipe, a fixing plate, second bearings, a spraying head, a first gear, a second gear, a second motor and a bracket are arranged and used cooperatively so as to solve the problem that spraying area ofexisting pesticide spraying equipment used for the modern agriculture cannot be increased, the pesticide spraying equipment for modern agriculture has the advantage that the spraying area can be increased, in the spraying process, the efficiency of spraying pesticide is improved, the time of spraying the pesticide is shortened, labour amount of a user is reduced, and the equipment can is conveniently used by the user and worthy of use and popularization.

title: CONTROLLER FOR SWITCHING FORWARD AND BACKWARD RUNNING OF TRACTOR
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve working efficiency by narrowing a butt while easily carrying out a turning operation of a tractor at the end of a farm field. SOLUTION: A levee sensor 40 is installed at the front part of the body of the tractor 10. A sensing part 43 is reacted and a levee 45 is sensed when a contact part 42 of the levee sensor 40 is brought into contact with the levee 45 at the end of the farm field. The body is moved backward only by a certain length required for turning the body at the time.

title: Farmland irrigation device
abstract: The invention discloses a farmland irrigation device and belongs to the technical field of agricultural irrigation. The farmland irrigation device comprises a water tank which is buried inside a soillayer, the upper end of the water tank is connected with an upright, the surface of the upright is connected with a transverse column, a hanging rod connected with the upright is arranged at the upperend of the transverse column, a solar panel connected with the top of the upright is arranged at the upper end of the hanging rod, the lower end of the transverse column is connected with a small nozzle, each of the left and right ends of the transverse column is connected with a big nozzle which is formed by connecting a rotating part with a spraying pipe, the surface of a water nozzle of each spraying pipe is connected with a support which is slidably connected with a shading plate, a limiting plate for reinforcing the corresponding shading plate is arranged on the outer side of each shading plate, and the bottom of each support is connected with an anti-falling strip for preventing the corresponding shading plate from sliding down. The farmland irrigation device is wide in irrigation range, high in irrigation water utilization rate, capable of realizing distance gradually-changing irrigation, free of irrigation dead zone and capable of increasing crop yield.

title: Agricultural seed sensing and control system
abstract: An example agricultural machine comprises a material distribution system that includes a material distribution line configured to convey particulate material to a component. The agricultural machine comprises a sensing system that includes a first sensor configured to generate a first sensor signal indicative of a measure of a flow of the particulate material in the material distribution line, a second sensor configured to generate a second sensor signal indicative of a measure of the flow of the particulate material in the material distribution line, and a correlation generation component configured to receive indications of the first and second sensor signals and to generate a correlation metric that represents a correlation between the first and second sensor signals. In one example, the correlation metric is applied to a sensor signal from a second material distribution line to determine a flow rate in the second material distribution line.

title: Methods for acquiring field condition data
abstract: A method for acquiring agricultural data using a UAV is provided. In several embodiments, the method includes receiving data associated with a data collection point located within a field and controlling an operation of the UAV such that the UAV is flown over the field and lands in the field at the data collection point. In such an embodiment, the method includes capturing field condition data associated with the field using a sensing device supported by the UAV. The field condition data is captured by the sensing device while the UAV is maintained in a landed condition at the data collection point.

title: Seeding machine for corn seed breeding
abstract: The invention provides a seeding machine for corn seed breeding, and belongs to the technical field of the agricultural machinery. The seeding machine for core seed breeding comprises a car body, a first ditching mechanism, a fertilization mechanism, a first earthing mechanism, a second ditching mechanism, a seeding mechanism, a second earthing mechanism and a watering mechanism; the first ditching mechanism, the fertilization mechanism, the first earthing mechanism, the second ditching mechanism, the seeding mechanism, the second earthing mechanism and the watering mechanism are orderly arranged on the car body; the second earthing mechanism and the first earthing mechanism have the same structure; the second ditching mechanism is arranged on a side of the first earthing mechanism. By arranging the first ditching mechanism, the fertilization mechanism, the first earthing mechanism, the second ditching mechanism, the seeding mechanism, the second earthing mechanism and the watering mechanism, the automatic corn seeding is realized, the hand labor is reduced, the seeds and the fertilizer can be seeded at the same time, or the dual-row alternative seeding can be realized, the distance between the seed and the fertilizer can be precisely controlled, and the automatic irrigation is realized.
